title: Connection budget and queue pressure
description: Tune client demand and pool limits. The model shows when PgBouncer contains a burst, consumes reserve connections, exceeds PostgreSQL's budget, or lets a queue outlive its deadline.

workloads.label: Steady short API
workloads.detail: One application role and database, with brief transactions and low simultaneous activity.

workloads.label: Bursty multi-role API
workloads.detail: Three database/user pairs share the budget while a burst raises active demand.

workloads.label: Slow transaction incident
workloads.detail: Two pools hold server connections longer, turning the same client fan-in into queue pressure.
